subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Astonished: A Hawthorn Asylum Novel
email_body:
Hi Kelsey,

Your new historical novel Astonished is set in 1914 at Hawthorn Asylum, following the superintendent's daughter Avila Kohlfeld and an asylum mortician named Matthias Ward. I was also struck that its release on July 24 was timed to the feast day of St. Christina the Astonishing, the saint who inspired the story. It is a distinctive premise for historical fiction readers.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Astonished: A Hawthorn Asylum Novel is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Astonished: A Hawthorn Asylum Novel best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
